metaTitle: Custom Gray Arm Sleeves | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gray arm sleeves in bulk for teams or events. Perfect Imprints offers quality options with your logo.
introHtml: Gray arm sleeves offer a neutral, professional look that pairs well with most uniform colors and work environments. For safety managers equipping warehouse staff or marketing directors outfitting event crews, gray hides dirt better than white while remaining highly visible. These sleeves provide UV protection and moisture-wicking comfort for outdoor or industrial use. Choose screen printing or embroidery to add your company logo or team name for a cohesive branded appearance.
heroAltText: Custom gray arm sleeves with embroidered logo on a neutral background, showing moisture-wicking fabric and UV protection.
